verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official MCP server for AI clients, OAuth sign-in, and a skill.md setup, but never mentions an official SDK in any language. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The MCP server is a different integration surface and does not count as an SDK, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
